ns2:section.sectionText: Asynchronous online. No synchronous time/day. Canvas LMS. No late adds after start of first class without prior written permission of the professor at bmbarnet@illinois.edu. Cross listed with HDFS 424 and AFRO 421. No Audit, Credit/No Credit, or Non-Degree enrollments. Restricted to Juniors, Seniors, and Graduate students with Degree status. Not for students with Freshman, Sophomore, Undergraduate Non-Degree, or Graduate Non-Degree class standing.
